bugs.name: Exact-name model search omits an existing model
bugs.summary: Searching the Models list for the exact title of an existing model returns an empty state, reproducibly after refresh, while a control search by a different model title succeeds.
bugs.expected: Searching for “Model Save Warning QA 1c63e50d” should show that model’s row with its slug, visibility, and model type.
bugs.actual: The settled search shows “No models match ‘Model Save Warning QA 1c63e50d’” and no row, although the same model is present in the unfiltered list. The empty result persists after refresh.
reproSteps: Load the provided administrator session; the dashboard identifies the signed-in account as admin@example.com. No credentials were entered and no new fixture was needed.
Open /models/ and select Models under the Modeling section of the sidebar.
In the unfiltered list, locate the existing row titled “Model Save Warning QA 1c63e50d” with slug “model-save-warning-qa-1c63e50d,” visibility “Not published,” and model type “Brand.”

Enter “Model Save Warning QA 1c63e50d” in Search models. At /models/?asc=true&sort=title&query=Model%20Save%20Warning%20QA%201c63e50d, wait for the list to settle; it displays “No models match ‘Model Save Warning QA 1c63e50d’” and no result row.

Refresh the exact-title search and confirm the same empty state remains. As a control within the same search flow, search for “Damaged Item” and confirm its row appears, then re-enter the target title and observe the empty state again.

bugs.name: Models scheduled for future publication are listed as Published
bugs.summary: The Models list reports future-scheduled hidden models as Published immediately.
bugs.expected: The list shows the model as hidden or scheduled until its future publication date.
bugs.actual: The Models list shows a green Published badge, while reopening detail shows Hidden and will be visible from the future date. Unscheduled hidden models show Not published. Reproduced on two models.
reproSteps: Sign in and open Modeling > Models.
Create a model, select a type, enter a unique title, choose Hidden, and Save.
Enable Set availability date, enter a future Publish on date such as January 1, 2028 at 10:00, and Save.
Click All models and inspect the model's Visibility.
Reopen the model.

reviewedVariants.name: Models list labels future scheduled, hidden models as Published
reviewedVariants.summary: The Visibility column ignores future publication dates, contradicting the model's Hidden status on its detail page.
reviewedVariants.expected: The models list should indicate Hidden or Scheduled until the publication date, consistently with the detail page.
reviewedVariants.actual: A model scheduled for November1,2026 at9:30AM has the checked detail radio 'Hidden will be visible from Sun, Nov1,2026,9:30AM', but the All models list's Visibility column says Published. Reproduced on two models, including a fresh schedule set after resetting the second to unscheduled Hidden.
reproSteps: Open a test model, such as Alpine Verification0603 (model17), and select Hidden; save.
Check Set availability date, enter2026-11-01T09:30, and Save.
Observe the checked visibility option explicitly says Hidden and will be visible at the future date.
Return to All models. In the table with Title, Slug, Visibility and Model Type headers, the same model's Visibility reads Published.
Reopen the model and confirm it still says Hidden with the future date. The same contradiction was reproduced on model16 with October15 scheduling.

bugs.name: Opening a deleted model shows a broken Create model form instead of a missing-record state
bugs.summary: A bookmarked deleted-model URL falls back to an unusable creation form whose required model-type picker cannot be populated.
bugs.expected: Display a model-not-found state or redirect to the models list. If offering creation, provide a functional new-model form at its proper route.
bugs.actual: After deleting model19 via its model type's confirmed cascade deletion, opening its saved URL displayed blank 'Create model' with Visible selected and an empty Model Type. The picker opened but offered no options. Filling Title and saving failed required Model Type, which could not be selected. Hard reload reproduced the same state.
reproSteps: Create a disposable model type, QA cascaded type0607, and a model of that type, QA cascaded model0607 (model19).
Record its detail URL: /models/UGFnZToxOQ%3D%3D.
Delete the disposable model type, acknowledge the cascade checkbox and confirm. Verify the type and model disappear from their lists.
Open the recorded model URL or use a saved bookmark.
Observe the blank Create model form rather than a not-found message.
Open Select model type; no options are available. Enter a Title and Save; the unreachable Model Type remains required.
Hard reload and repeat; the broken form persists.
